verification.requestBoundSchemaExplanation: The unchanged buildNyxRepairIntentContract places scoped observation/evidence identifiers into enums. Policy and bounds are shared, but raw schemas differ. No normalized live schema/prompt equivalence claim is made.

interpretation.explanation: Both configurations solved all four small unseeded tasks. The sole v2 quality rejection was corrected from ordinary measured feedback with no concrete proposal. Treatment was never invoked, so its fewer calls/tokens and 4/4 first-attempt result cannot be caused by the new grammar. This is positive task capability evidence, not an architectural improvement or frontier result.

hostProfile.limitation: Sequential control-first, unblinded, unrandomized microprofile with warm-up effects and different rewrite counts; not a speedup comparison, model budget or total-host-compute match.

research.scope: Language evaluation order motivates a conservative first-value guard. It does not prove whole-program equivalence or NYX improvement.

pluginDiscovery.note: Returned Snowflake and G2 do not establish a quota-enforcing Terminal-Bench/SWE execution environment. No unsupported plugin recommendation or connection was made; search is not exhaustive.

conflicts: Positive 4/4 final scores do not demonstrate an unexercised mechanism. Confidence cannot substitute for benchmark coverage.

nextEvidenceSupportedAction: Do not promote or expand v3 from this epoch. Any further efficacy study must first predeclare a genuine quality-repair opportunity shared by both arms and separate supplied-candidate component evidence from unseeded task performance; fresh transfer and compute-matched acceptance remain required. Prioritize actual observed reasoning failures and real benchmark execution prerequisites rather than more unexercised proposer layers.
